title: Stable Causality and Microcausality for Drummond-Hathrell Photons
summary: Local superluminal photon propagation arises at $\mathcal{O}(α/m_e^2)$ in the Drummond Hathrell (DH) effective action obtained by integrating out the electron in QED coupled to gravity. Whether such superluminality implies a genuine violation of causality in curved spacetime is subtle and remains conceptually nontrivial. In this work we revisit this question using two complementary and largely symmetry-independent diagnostics.
